def visit(closure, kind, key, value):
    if kind != KIND:
        return False
    from . import multivariate_control as controls
    from . import geographic_study_transfer as geographic
    checked = controls.inspect(closure.workspace, key)
    if {k: v for k, v in checked.items() if k != "adoption"} != value:
        raise ValueError("The selected control design changed during capture")
    prefix = KIND + "/" + identifier(key)
    closure.tree(prefix)
    bound = value["binding"]
    for name in ("baseline_run_id", "restoration_run_id"):
        closure.need("runs", bound[name], "Original matched-control cohort")
    closure.need("grids", bound["grid_id"], "Original matched-control grid")
    closure.need("profiles", bound["profile_id"], "Original matched-control profile")
    closure.need("sources", value["source"]["source_collection_id"], "Complete design and assessment source")
    closure._source_refs(bound, "Original matched-control scientific inputs")
    geographic._footprint(closure, bound["restoration_footprint_id"], bound["restoration_run_id"])
    if checked.get("adoption"):
        adoption = checked["adoption"]
        closure.need("scenarios", adoption["scenario_id"], "Adopted original control scenario")
        closure.need("runs", adoption["run_id"], "Adopted original control run")
        closure.need("experiments", adoption["experiment_id"], "Original control experiment and progress")
        geographic._footprint(closure, adoption["footprint_id"], adoption["run_id"])
    return True


def lock_paths(closure):
    for kind, key in sorted(closure.nodes):
        if kind == KIND:
            yield KIND + "/" + key + "/.design.lock"
            yield KIND + "/" + key + "/.adopt.lock"


def include_source(closure, collection_id, entry):
    uri = entry.get("uri", "")
    if not isinstance(uri, str) or not uri.startswith(URI):
        return False
    key = identifier(uri[len(URI):])
    metadata = entry.get("metadata") or {}
    if (entry.get("kind") != "document" or entry.get("role") != "OBSERVED_CONTEXT"
            or metadata.get("report_schema") != "upstate.observed-report/v1"
            or metadata.get("multivariate_control_id") != key):
        raise ValueError("Original matched-control scientific source identity changed")
    bodies = [entry["body"], *entry.get("companions", [])]
    members = {}
    for body in bodies:
        name = body.get("view_path", body["filename"])
        if name in members:
            raise ValueError("Control source repeats a native member")
        members[name] = body
        closure.add_file(body["object"], body)
    recipe = closure.read(entry["body"]["object"])
    if recipe.get("schema") != "upstate.observed-report/v1":
        raise ValueError("Control source is not its original scientific recipe")
    expected = {r["path"]: (r["bytes"], r["sha256"]) for r in recipe["inputs"]}
    actual = {name: (body["bytes"], body["sha256"]) for name, body in members.items()
              if body is not entry["body"]}
    if expected != actual or len(expected) != len(recipe["inputs"]):
        raise ValueError("Control source lost its full assessment/mask companions")
    assessment_body = members.get("assessment.json")
    if assessment_body is None:
        raise ValueError("Control source lost the original assessment")
    assessment = closure.read(assessment_body["object"])
    if (assessment.get("id") != key or digest(assessment["identity"]) != key
            or assessment["identity"]["project_id"] != metadata.get("project_id")):
        raise ValueError("Control source assessment differs from the original design")
    lineage = {"source_collection_id": collection_id, "source_id": entry["id"],
               "report_context_kind": "multivariate_control",
               "project_id": metadata["project_id"], "design_id": key,
               "assessment_sha256": assessment_body["sha256"],
               "relationship": "same_project" if metadata["project_id"] == closure.workspace.project["id"] else "external"}
    if lineage["relationship"] == "same_project":
        record = closure.read(KIND + "/" + key + "/design.json")
        if (record["identity"] != assessment["identity"] or record["summary"] != assessment["summary"]
                or record["strata"] != assessment["strata"] or record["balance"] != assessment["balance"]):
            raise ValueError("Selected control source no longer matches its native design")
        native = {r["path"].removeprefix(KIND + "/" + key + "/"): (r["bytes"], r["sha256"])
                  for r in record["files"]}
        if any(native.get(name) != (body["bytes"], body["sha256"]) for name, body in members.items()):
            raise ValueError("Equivalent imported control source differs from the complete original native edition")
        closure.need(KIND, key, "Editable design behind selected control report")
    closure.report_source_records[(collection_id, entry["id"])] = lineage
    return True

BIN_RULE = "lower-inclusive upper-exclusive; outer bins unbounded; exact boundary enters the higher bin"


class Moments:
    def __init__(self):
        self.n = 0
        self.mean = 0.0
        self.m2 = 0.0
        self.low = None
        self.high = None
        self.abs_sum = 0.0
        self.abs_max = 0.0

    def add(self, values):
        values = np.asarray(values, dtype=np.float64)
        if not values.size:
            return
        if not np.isfinite(values).all():
            raise ValueError("Statistics received an undeclared missing/nonfinite value")
        n = int(values.size)
        mean = float(values.mean())
        m2 = float(np.square(values - mean).sum())
        delta, total = mean - self.mean, self.n + n
        self.m2 += m2 + delta * delta * self.n * n / total
        self.mean += delta * n / total
        self.n = total
        lo, hi = float(values.min()), float(values.max())
        self.low = lo if self.low is None else min(self.low, lo)
        self.high = hi if self.high is None else max(self.high, hi)
        self.abs_sum += float(np.abs(values).sum())
        self.abs_max = max(self.abs_max, float(np.abs(values).max()))

    def value(self, residual=False):
        row = {"count": self.n, "mean": self.mean if self.n else None,
               "population_sd": math.sqrt(max(0, self.m2 / self.n)) if self.n else None,
               "minimum": self.low, "maximum": self.high}
        if residual:
            row.update(mean_absolute=self.abs_sum / self.n if self.n else None,
                       max_absolute=self.abs_max if self.n else None)
        return row

        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())


def _stats(role, units, key, target, candidate, control=None, residual=None):
    control, residual = control or Moments(), residual or Moments()
    a, b = target.value(), control.value()
    pooled = (math.sqrt((a["population_sd"] ** 2 + b["population_sd"] ** 2) / 2)
              if a["count"] and b["count"] else None)
    standardized = ((b["mean"] - a["mean"]) / pooled if pooled
                    else (0.0 if pooled == 0 and a["mean"] == b["mean"] else None))
    return {"stratum": key, "role": role, "units": units,
            "target": a, "candidate": candidate.value(), "control": b,
            "residual": residual.value(True),
            "standardized_mean_difference": standardized,
            "population_basis": ("field-finite pre-admission treatment/candidate; control/residual use selected pairs"
                                 if key == "__all__" else "fully admitted exact-stratum target/candidate; selected control pairs")}


def compute(ws, selected, bound, directory, *, progress=None):
    """Complete design or explicit nonacceptance; no source/native mutation."""
    import rasterio
    from rasterio.windows import Window

    root = Path(directory)
    work = root / "work"
    work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    # Rebuilding this owned scratch roster after interruption cannot overwrite
    # a completed design. prepare holds the design lock and checks it first.
    for path in work.glob("*.bin"):
        path.unlink()
    roles = [r for r in bound["files"] if r not in ("NLCD", "reporting_mask")]
    units = {r: bound["files"][r]["units"] for r in roles}
    dtype = np.dtype([("index", "<u8")] + [(r, "<f8") for r in roles])
    budget = selected["max_working_bytes"]
    window_side = 256
    window_estimate = window_side ** 2 * (len(roles) * 64 + 256) + 16 * 1024 * 1024
    if budget < window_estimate:
        raise MemoryError("Declared working bytes are below this exact window scan requirement: " + str(window_estimate))
    transitions = {}
    for row in bound["restoration_transitions"]:
        before, after = int(row["from_code"]), int(row["to_code"])
        if before == after or not row["cells"]:
            continue
        if before in transitions and transitions[before] != after:
            raise ValueError("This edition requires one destination per original class; select a treatment without competing destination pools")
        transitions[before] = after
    if not transitions:
        raise ValueError("No retained changed transition exists")
    strata, populations = {}, {}
    overall = {r: {p: Moments() for p in ("target", "candidate", "control", "residual")} for r in roles}
    counts = {"original_changed_cells": 0, "reporting_target_cells": 0,
              "outside_reporting_target_cells": 0, "missing_target_cells": 0,
              "eligible_target_cells": 0, "candidate_base_cells": 0,
              "excluded_candidate_cells": 0, "missing_candidate_cells": 0,
              "eligible_candidate_cells": 0, "matched_cells": 0}
    actual_transitions = {}

    def emit(stage, **values):
        if progress:
            progress({"stage": stage, **values})

    def append(key, kind, indices, data, selected_cells):
        path = work / (key + "-" + kind + ".bin")
        records = np.empty(int(selected_cells.sum()), dtype=dtype)
        records["index"] = indices[selected_cells]
        for role in roles:
            records[role] = np.where(_valid(data[role]), data[role].data, np.nan)[selected_cells]
        with path.open("ab") as stream:
            records.tofile(stream)

    with ExitStack() as stack:
        sources = {r: stack.enter_context(rasterio.open(verify_file(ws.root, d)))
                   for r, d in bound["files"].items()}
        baseline = sources["NLCD"]
        if baseline.crs is None or not baseline.crs.is_projected:
            raise ValueError("Use the original projected native grid")
        if not math.isclose(float(baseline.crs.linear_units_factor[1]), 1.0, rel_tol=0, abs_tol=1e-12):
            raise ValueError("The original native grid must use metre coordinates")
        for role, source in sources.items():
            _same_grid(baseline, source, role)
        restoration = stack.enter_context(rasterio.open(verify_file(ws.root, bound["restoration_files"]["scenario_lulc"])))
        _same_grid(baseline, restoration, "Original restoration footprint")
        actual_native = None
        if bound.get("native_landcover"):
            actual_native = stack.enter_context(rasterio.open(verify_file(ws.root, bound["native_landcover"])))
            _same_grid(baseline, actual_native, "Executed restoration land cover")
        exclusion = None
        if bound.get("exclusion_source"):
            body = bound["exclusion_source"]["entry"]["body"]
            exclusion = stack.enter_context(rasterio.open(relative_file(ws.root, body["object"])))
            _same_grid(baseline, exclusion, "Original exclusion raster")
        width, height = baseline.width, baseline.height
        affine = baseline.transform
        pixel_area = abs(affine.a * affine.e - affine.b * affine.d) / 10000
        if not math.isclose(pixel_area, bound["restoration_summary"]["pixel_area_ha"], rel_tol=0, abs_tol=1e-10):
            raise ValueError("Original footprint and native-grid cell areas differ")
        with (root / "unmatched-targets.csv").open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as missing:
            missing_writer = csv.writer(missing)
            missing_writer.writerow(["target_index", "row", "col", "from_code", "to_code", "reason", "missing_roles"])
            for row in range(0, height, window_side):
                for col in range(0, width, window_side):
                    win = Window(col, row, min(window_side, width-col), min(window_side, height-row))
                    data = {r: src.read(1, window=win, masked=True) for r, src in sources.items()}
                    base, restored = data["NLCD"], restoration.read(1, window=win, masked=True)
                    bvalid, rvalid = _valid(base), _valid(restored)
                    if not np.array_equal(bvalid, rvalid):
                        raise ValueError("Restoration changed original categorical NoData support")
                    if np.any(bvalid & ((base.data != np.floor(base.data)) | (restored.data != np.floor(restored.data)))):
                        raise ValueError("Original categorical bands contain noninteger codes")
                    if actual_native is not None:
                        executed = actual_native.read(1, window=win, masked=True)
                        if (not np.array_equal(rvalid, _valid(executed))
                                or not np.array_equal(restored.data[rvalid], executed.data[rvalid])):
                            raise ValueError("Selected footprint differs from the actual executed restoration land cover")
                    report = data["reporting_mask"]
                    rv = _valid(report)
                    if np.any(rv & ~np.isin(report.data, [0, 1])):
                        raise ValueError("The original reporting mask is not binary")
                    reporting = rv & (report.data == 1)
                    changed = bvalid & (base.data != restored.data)
                    counts["original_changed_cells"] += int(changed.sum())
                    counts["reporting_target_cells"] += int((changed & reporting).sum())
                    counts["outside_reporting_target_cells"] += int((changed & ~reporting).sum())
                    if np.any(changed):
                        pairs, frequencies = np.unique(np.column_stack((base.data[changed], restored.data[changed])), axis=0, return_counts=True)
                        for pair, number in zip(pairs, frequencies):
                            key = (int(pair[0]), int(pair[1]))
                            actual_transitions[key] = actual_transitions.get(key, 0) + int(number)
                            if transitions.get(key[0]) != key[1]:
                                raise ValueError("Actual changed cells differ from retained original transition accounting")
                    target = changed & reporting
                    candidate_base = bvalid & reporting & ~changed & np.isin(base.data, list(transitions))
                    counts["candidate_base_cells"] += int(candidate_base.sum())
                    excluded = np.zeros(changed.shape, dtype=bool)
                    if exclusion is not None:
                        ex = exclusion.read(1, window=win, masked=True)
                        ev = _valid(ex)
                        if np.any(ev & ~np.isin(ex.data, [0, 1])):
                            raise ValueError("Original exclusion source must be a binary raster")
                        # Unknown exclusion support is not admitted as an available control.
                        excluded = ~ev | (ex.data == 1)
                    counts["excluded_candidate_cells"] += int((candidate_base & excluded).sum())
                    candidate = candidate_base & ~excluded
                    scalar_valid = {r: _valid(data[r]) for r in roles}
                    scalar_valid["PRECIPITATION"] &= data["PRECIPITATION"].data >= 0
                    # Unselected balance fields do not reduce matching support.
                    admission_roles = list(dict.fromkeys(["PRECIPITATION"] + [r["role"] for r in selected["strata"]]))
                    complete = np.logical_and.reduce([scalar_valid[r] for r in admission_roles])
                    counts["missing_target_cells"] += int((target & ~complete).sum())
                    counts["missing_candidate_cells"] += int((candidate & ~complete).sum())
                    eligible_target, eligible_candidate = target & complete, candidate & complete
                    counts["eligible_target_cells"] += int(eligible_target.sum())
                    counts["eligible_candidate_cells"] += int(eligible_candidate.sum())
                    for role in roles:
                        overall[role]["target"].add(data[role].data[target & scalar_valid[role]])
                        overall[role]["candidate"].add(data[role].data[candidate & scalar_valid[role]])
                    rr, cc = np.indices(changed.shape, dtype=np.uint64)
                    indices = (rr + row) * width + cc + col
                    for bad in (changed & ~reporting, target & ~complete):
                        for y, x in np.argwhere(bad):
                            reason = "outside_original_reporting_support" if not reporting[y, x] else "missing_selected_covariate"
                            missing_roles = [r for r in admission_roles if not scalar_valid[r][y, x]]
                            missing_writer.writerow([int(indices[y, x]), row+int(y), col+int(x),
                                                     int(base.data[y, x]), int(restored.data[y, x]),
                                                     reason, "|".join(missing_roles)])
                    admitted = eligible_target | eligible_candidate
                    if not np.any(admitted):
                        continue
                    bins = [np.searchsorted(s["boundaries"], data[s["role"]].data, side="right")
                            for s in selected["strata"]]
                    matrix = np.column_stack([base.data[admitted].astype(np.int64)] + [b[admitted] for b in bins])
                    for combination in np.unique(matrix, axis=0):
                        from_code = int(combination[0])
                        selected_cells = admitted & (base.data == from_code)
                        for bin_array, index in zip(bins, combination[1:]):
                            selected_cells &= bin_array == index
                        definition = {"from_code": from_code, "to_code": transitions[from_code],
                                      "bins": [int(x) for x in combination[1:]]}
                        key = digest(definition)
                        if key not in strata:
                            strata[key] = {"key": key, **definition, "target_cells": 0,
                                           "eligible_target_cells": 0, "candidate_cells": 0,
                                           "matched_cells": 0, "state": "pending", "reasons": []}
                        for kind, eligible, count_field in (("target", eligible_target, "target_cells"),
                                                           ("candidate", eligible_candidate, "candidate_cells")):
                            choose = selected_cells & eligible
                            number = int(choose.sum())
                            strata[key][count_field] += number
                            if number:
                                append(key, kind, indices, data, choose)
                emit("scan", rows=min(height, row+window_side), total_rows=height, counts=counts)
            missing.flush()
            os.fsync(missing.fileno())
        if counts["original_changed_cells"] != int(bound["restoration_summary"]["net_changed_cells"]):
            raise ValueError("Actual treatment count differs from original complete footprint")
        expected_transitions = {(int(r["from_code"]), int(r["to_code"])): int(r["cells"])
                                for r in bound["restoration_transitions"] if r["from_code"] != r["to_code"] and r["cells"]}
        if actual_transitions != expected_transitions:
            raise ValueError("Actual original categorical transition roster differs")
        masks = {}
        balance = []
        fields = ["stratum", "from_code", "to_code", "target_index", "control_index", "target_row",
                  "target_col", "control_row", "control_col"]
        for role in roles:
            fields.extend(["target_" + role, "control_" + role, "residual_" + role])
        failure = bool(counts["missing_target_cells"] or counts["outside_reporting_target_cells"])
        threshold_failed = False
        with (root / "matched-pairs.csv").open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as output:
            writer = csv.DictWriter(output, fieldnames=fields)
            writer.writeheader()
            for key in sorted(strata):
                item = strata[key]
                n, m = item["target_cells"], item["candidate_cells"]
                item["eligible_target_cells"] = n
                if n == 0:
                    item["state"] = "candidate_only"
                    continue
                required = (256*n + 96*m + 256*1024*1024 + 3*dtype.itemsize*(n+m)
                            if m >= n else window_estimate + 3*dtype.itemsize*(n+m))
                if budget < required:
                    raise MemoryError("Stratum " + key + " requires declared working bytes >= " + str(required))
                targets = np.fromfile(work / (key + "-target.bin"), dtype=dtype)
                candidate_path = work / (key + "-candidate.bin")
                candidates = np.fromfile(candidate_path, dtype=dtype) if candidate_path.exists() else np.empty(0, dtype=dtype)
                if targets.size != n or candidates.size != m:
                    raise ValueError("Retained stratum roster is incomplete")
                local = {role: {name: Moments() for name in ("target", "candidate", "control", "residual")} for role in roles}
                for role in roles:
                    local[role]["target"].add(targets[role][np.isfinite(targets[role])])
                    local[role]["candidate"].add(candidates[role][np.isfinite(candidates[role])])
                if m < n:
                    item["state"] = "infeasible"
                    item["reasons"].append("Insufficient disjoint same-class covariate-stratum candidates")
                    failure = True
                    with (root / "unmatched-targets.csv").open("a", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as missing:
                        missing_writer = csv.writer(missing)
                        for target_id in targets["index"]:
                            target_id = int(target_id)
                            missing_writer.writerow([target_id, target_id//width, target_id%width,
                                item["from_code"], item["to_code"], "insufficient_stratum_candidates:" + key, ""])
                else:
                    required = 256*n + 96*m + 256*1024*1024 + 3*dtype.itemsize*(n+m)
                    if budget < required:
                        raise MemoryError("Stratum " + key + " exact matching requires declared working bytes >= " + str(required))
                    matched = match_precipitation(targets["PRECIPITATION"], candidates["PRECIPITATION"],
                        target_ids=targets["index"], candidate_ids=candidates["index"])
                    chosen = candidates[matched.candidate_positions]
                    if np.unique(chosen["index"]).size != n or np.intersect1d(targets["index"], chosen["index"]).size:
                        raise ValueError("Original matching violated unique disjoint cell identity")
                    maximum = float(np.abs(chosen["PRECIPITATION"] - targets["PRECIPITATION"]).max())
                    item["matching"] = matched.metadata()
                    objective = item["matching"].pop("objective_sum_absolute_precipitation_residual_mm_year")
                    item["matching"].update(objective_sum_absolute_proxy_residual=objective,
                                             proxy_units=units["PRECIPITATION"], optimization="minimum total absolute original runoff-proxy residual within this stratum", matching_scope="this exact original-class/covariate stratum",
                                             caliper_rule="acceptance gate on the selected unconstrained L1 optimum")
                    item["state"] = "matched"
                    if selected["precipitation_caliper"] is not None and maximum > selected["precipitation_caliper"]:
                        item["state"] = "threshold_not_met"
                        item["reasons"].append("Selected unconstrained optimum fails the declared caliper; this does not prove no feasible assignment exists")
                        threshold_failed = True
                    item["matched_cells"] = n
                    counts["matched_cells"] += n
                    mask_key = (item["from_code"], item["to_code"])
                    if mask_key not in masks:
                        path = work / ("mask-%s-%s.bin" % mask_key)
                        masks[mask_key] = np.memmap(path, mode="w+", dtype="uint8", shape=(height, width))
                        stack.callback(masks[mask_key]._mmap.close)
                        masks[mask_key][:] = 0
                    flat = masks[mask_key].reshape(-1)
                    if np.any(flat[chosen["index"]] != 0):
                        raise ValueError("A candidate cell was reused across matching strata")
                    flat[chosen["index"]] = 1
                    for role in roles:
                        # Balance-only NoData was encoded as NaN in the record.
                        valid = np.isfinite(targets[role]) & np.isfinite(chosen[role])
                        local[role]["control"].add(chosen[role][np.isfinite(chosen[role])])
                        local[role]["residual"].add(chosen[role][valid] - targets[role][valid])
                        overall[role]["control"].add(chosen[role][np.isfinite(chosen[role])])
                        overall[role]["residual"].add(chosen[role][valid] - targets[role][valid])
                    for index in range(n):
                        target_id, control_id = int(targets["index"][index]), int(chosen["index"][index])
                        pair = {"stratum": key, "from_code": item["from_code"], "to_code": item["to_code"],
                                "target_index": target_id, "control_index": control_id,
                                "target_row": target_id//width, "target_col": target_id%width,
                                "control_row": control_id//width, "control_col": control_id%width}
                        for role in roles:
                            a, b = float(targets[role][index]), float(chosen[role][index])
                            pair["target_" + role] = a if math.isfinite(a) else ""
                            pair["control_" + role] = b if math.isfinite(b) else ""
                            pair["residual_" + role] = b-a if math.isfinite(a) and math.isfinite(b) else ""
                        writer.writerow(pair)
                for role in roles:
                    balance.append(_stats(role, units[role], key, **local[role]))
                emit("matching", stratum=key, state=item["state"], matched_cells=counts["matched_cells"])
            output.flush()
            os.fsync(output.fileno())
        for role in roles:
            balance.append(_stats(role, units[role], "__all__", **overall[role]))
        state = "infeasible" if failure else ("threshold_not_met" if threshold_failed else "prepared")
        if state == "prepared" and counts["matched_cells"] != counts["original_changed_cells"]:
            raise ValueError("Accepted control must match every original treatment cell")
        mask_files = []
        for pair, data in sorted(masks.items()):
            data.flush()
            if state == "prepared":
                name = "control-%s-to-%s.tif" % pair
                path = root / name
                with rasterio.open(path, "w", driver="GTiff", width=width, height=height,
                        count=1, dtype="uint8", crs=baseline.crs, transform=affine, nodata=255,
                        tiled=True, blockxsize=256, blockysize=256, compress="deflate", BIGTIFF="IF_SAFER") as destination:
                    actual_count = 0
                    for row in range(0, height, window_side):
                        for col in range(0, width, window_side):
                            win = Window(col, row, min(window_side, width-col), min(window_side, height-row))
                            original = baseline.read(1, window=win, masked=True)
                            array = np.array(data[row:row+int(win.height), col:col+int(win.width)])
                            actual_count += int((array == 1).sum())
                            array[~_valid(original)] = 255
                            destination.write(array, 1, window=win)
                    destination.update_tags(role="MULTIVARIATE_CONTROL_MASK",
                        meaning="Analyst-declared matched model scenario, not an observed intervention",
                        from_code=pair[0], to_code=pair[1])
                if actual_count != actual_transitions[pair]:
                    raise ValueError("Final original transition count differs from complete matched mask")
                mask_files.append({"from_code": pair[0], "to_code": pair[1],
                                   "cells": actual_count, "hectares": actual_count*pixel_area,
                                   "file": describe_file(root, path)})
        # Release maps before scratch cleanup, including on Windows recipients.
        masks.clear()
    summary = {**counts, "original_changed_hectares": counts["original_changed_cells"]*pixel_area,
               "matched_hectares": counts["matched_cells"]*pixel_area, "pixel_area_ha": pixel_area,
               "grid_id": bound["grid_id"], "state": state, "bin_rule": BIN_RULE,
               "precipitation_units": units["PRECIPITATION"],
               "selected_dimensions": [s["role"] for s in selected["strata"]],
               "matched_dimensions": ["original class and destination transition"] + [s["role"] for s in selected["strata"] if s["boundaries"]],
               "unmatched_dimensions": [r for r in ("DEM", "K_FACTOR", "R_FACTOR", "SLOPE", "CONNECTIVITY")
                                        if r not in {s["role"] for s in selected["strata"] if s["boundaries"]}],
               "proxy_matching": "Exact unconstrained minimum total absolute residual separately within each declared stratum",
               "caliper": selected["precipitation_caliper"],
               "acceptance": "All treatment cells, enough unique controls in each stratum, and every selected pair passes the declared proxy threshold",
               "native_landcover_verified": bound.get("native_landcover") is not None,
               "unaccepted_reasons": (["Original treatment extends outside the declared reporting support"] if counts["outside_reporting_target_cells"] else []) + (["Original treatment has missing selected covariate support"] if counts["missing_target_cells"] else []) + (["One or more exact strata has fewer candidates than targets"] if any(r["state"] == "infeasible" for r in strata.values()) else []) + (["Selected unconstrained optimum exceeds the declared caliper"] if threshold_failed else []),
               "source_classification": "Original per-input source classifications remain in input-binding.json; no source is promoted to observed"}
    result = {"state": state, "summary": summary, "strata": [strata[k] for k in sorted(strata)],
              "balance": balance, "masks": mask_files}
    atomic_json(root / "matching-result.json", result, immutable=True)
    _write_csv(root / "balance.csv", ["stratum", "role", "units", "population", "count", "mean",
                                     "population_sd", "minimum", "maximum", "mean_absolute", "max_absolute"],
               ({"stratum": r["stratum"], "role": r["role"], "units": r["units"],
                 "population": name, **r[name]} for r in balance
                for name in ("target", "candidate", "control", "residual")))
    _write_csv(root / "strata.csv", ["key", "from_code", "to_code", "bins", "target_cells",
              "candidate_cells", "matched_cells", "state", "reasons"],
              ({k: ("|".join(map(str, r[k])) if isinstance(r[k], list) else r[k])
                for k in ("key", "from_code", "to_code", "bins", "target_cells",
                          "candidate_cells", "matched_cells", "state", "reasons")} for r in result["strata"]))
    # Input integrity is checked after the whole calculation before publication.
    for item in [*bound["files"].values(), *bound["restoration_files"].values()]:
        verify_file(ws.root, item)
    if bound.get("native_landcover"):
        verify_file(ws.root, bound["native_landcover"])
    shutil.rmtree(work)
    return result

"""Selected original scientific-report editions and their typed source history.

The report identity, order and bytes are retained. This resolver never renders a
report, rewrites its original Workspace path, or materializes source-view links.
The maintained source-lineage resolvers decide which editable studies accompany
each exact source collection.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath

from .common import digest, identifier, read_json
from . import observed_context

KIND = "scientific-report-editions"
SCHEMA = "upstate.scientific-report-edition/v1"
RECEIPT_SCHEMA = "upstate.study-scientific-report-edition/v1"
ROOT_KINDS = (KIND,)
DOCUMENTS = {KIND: "edition.json"}
LOCKS = {KIND: ".observed-report.lock"}
LABELS = {KIND: "Saved scientific reports"}


def _relative(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or "\\" in value or "\0" in value:
        raise ValueError("A saved scientific report needs an original relative member path.")
    path = PurePosixPath(value)
    if (path.is_absolute() or not path.parts or ".." in path.parts
            or path.as_posix() != value or any(":" in part for part in path.parts)):
        raise ValueError("A saved scientific report member must remain in its original directory.")
    return value


def _source(closure, choice, expected_source):
    """Validate a source binding through CAS objects without creating view links."""
    collection_id = identifier(choice["source_collection_id"])
    value = closure.read("sources/" + collection_id + ".json")
    if value.get("schema") != "upstate.sources/v1" or digest(value) != collection_id:
        raise ValueError("A scientific report's original source collection changed.")
    entries = [entry for entry in value.get("entries", [])
               if entry.get("id") == choice["source_id"]]
    if len(entries) != 1 or entries[0].get("kind") != "document":
        raise ValueError("The saved scientific report needs its exact original source document.")
    entry = entries[0]
    original_source = {
        **choice, "title": entry["title"], "vintage": entry["vintage"],
        "uri": entry["uri"], "body_bytes": entry["body"]["bytes"],
        "body_sha256": entry["body"]["sha256"],
    }
    if any(expected_source.get(name) != value for name, value in original_source.items()):
        raise ValueError("The saved report source roster differs from its original source edition.")
    members = {}
    for item in [entry["body"], *entry.get("companions", [])]:
        name = _relative(item.get("view_path", item["filename"]))
        if name in members:
            raise ValueError("A scientific report source repeats an original member path.")
        closure.add_file(item["object"], item)
        members[name] = item
    recipe = closure.read(entry["body"]["object"])
    if recipe.get("schema") != observed_context.SCHEMA:
        raise ValueError("The original scientific report document has another schema.")
    for item in recipe.get("inputs", []):
        name = _relative(item["path"])
        original = members.get(name)
        if original is None or any(original.get(field) != item.get(field)
                                   for field in ("bytes", "sha256")):
            raise ValueError("The scientific report lost an original source input: " + name)
    closure.need("sources", collection_id, "Ordered scientific report source " + entry["id"])

def _retain_geographic_checkpoint(args, error):
    """Preserve the same original receiving record at the owner's native cutoff."""
    output = args.output.resolve()
    receipt = output / "receiving.json"
    original = {}
    read_error = None
    if receipt.is_file():
        try:
            original = read_json(receipt)
            if original.get("schema") != "upstate.geographic-headwaters-receiving/v1":
                raise ValueError("The receiving receipt has another original schema")
        except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError) as problem:
            read_error = {"type": type(problem).__name__, "message": str(problem)}
            original = {}
    checkpoint = {
        "schema": "upstate.geographic-headwaters-checkpoint/v1",
        "cutoff": CUTOFF.isoformat(), "stopped_at": now(),
        "state": "cutoff" if isinstance(error, DemoDeadlineReached) else "interrupted",
        "workspace": str(args.workspace.resolve()), "output": str(output),
        "source_receipt": str(receipt) if receipt.exists() else None,
        "operation_id": original.get("operation_id"),
        "project_id": original.get("project_id"),
        "active_stage": original.get("active_stage"),
        "recorded_state": original.get("state"),
        "error": {"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)},
        "retained_receiving": original,
    }
    if read_error is not None:
        checkpoint["receipt_read_error"] = read_error
    atomic_json(output / "geographic-checkpoint.json", checkpoint)
    return checkpoint

# Multivariate matched-control designs

TokenJunkieLabs scientific engineering for the original Upper Savannah Workspace.
Current workflow: WO-19, ECO-MULTIVARIATE-CONTROLS-20261013. Original scientific method choices and interpretation remain with the prime.

## What the complete workflow does

Select an original baseline native run and an exact retained restoration footprint. Declare source-unit covariate boundaries and, optionally, an acceptance threshold for the prepared runoff proxy. The original exact one-dimensional Monge matcher selects distinct off-treatment control cells within each admitted original-class/covariate stratum. Save the full assessment, inspect remaining balance and missing support, and adopt an accepted design through the original source, scenario, native run and experiment writers.

The original baseline/restoration selections remain immutable. A different design gets its own saved ID, source collection, scenario, run and original experiment. Executing that original experiment reuses completed original cases; the control is the new native case. This module never replaces NDR/SDR, the original experiment queue or an existing control.

### Exact scientific scope

* The treatment population is every actual final baseline-to-restoration changed cell in the selected compiled footprint. A completed restoration must agree, cell for cell and support for support, with its retained native land-cover stage. A current compiler preview cannot silently replace an executed treatment.
* A successful design retains the entire original treatment count and from/to transition roster. Every treatment cell must lie in the original reporting mask and have every selected admission covariate. Missing support produces an unaccepted assessment; it does not shrink the design.
* Candidates are unchanged original cells inside the same reporting mask, of an original treatment class, outside the actual treatment and outside the optional explicit exclusion mask. Unknown exclusion support is excluded. Each control cell is used once.
* This first edition admits one destination code per original class. A treatment that changes one original class to competing destination classes is rejected explicitly before adoption; no independent matcher may reuse their shared candidate pool.
* Native DEM, R_FACTOR, K_FACTOR and PRECIPITATION values are the already-aligned and converted prepared grid. Their original source entries, classifications, source SHA, units, conversion and resampling history remain in input-binding.json. Conversion is not applied a second time.
* Optional SLOPE and CONNECTIVITY are explicitly chosen original single-band rasters on the exact native shape, CRS and affine transform. The analyst supplies real units and a physical definition. An unapplied conversion is rejected; select its original prepared output instead. DEM means elevation, not slope. A connectivity label alone never defines its physical quantity.
* Stratum boundaries are exact analyst-authored values. Bins are lower-inclusive/upper-exclusive, with unbounded outer bins; an exact edge enters the higher bin. An empty boundary list is one unconstrained bin and is labeled that way.
* The unchanged original matcher minimizes total absolute **prepared runoff-proxy** difference within each stratum. Metadata uses the actual source units. No per-stratum runoff normalization is introduced.
* The optional caliper is a post-match acceptance threshold for every selected pair. A failing selected unconstrained optimum gives **threshold_not_met**, which does not prove that no full caliper-feasible assignment exists. No target is removed and no threshold is relaxed.
* Exact class/area equality and stratification do not imply equal continuous covariates, equal slope/routing/connectivity, or a causal treatment effect. Every unstratified dimension remains named. The chosen land-cover transition changes the original corresponding coefficients and retention assumptions together.
* Separate record IDs or titles are not independent spatial placements. Compare the saved mask SHA values and original chosen cell IDs. New analyst-defined sources or boundaries can produce another placement; deterministic renaming supplies no extra simulation evidence.
* The matching preparation computes no pollutant reduction. Annual native N/P kg/year and sediment tonnes/year remain the original model results, with original common-support comparisons. They are modeled delivery to streams, not intake concentrations.

## Saved states

| State | Meaning | Available continuation |

"""Continue one authored matched-control study in the original geographic receiver.

This module is called by receive_geographic_headwaters.py. Its direct entry point
only reopens an already restored study with the source contained in that archive.
Native design, matching, adoption and execution remain in model.multivariate_control.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import uuid

APP = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(APP) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(APP))

from model.common import atomic_bytes, atomic_json, describe_file, digest, file_digest, identifier, now, read_json, verify_file
from model.workspace import Workspace
from source_tools.geographic_headwaters_reopen import receiving_lock, _lock_identity

SCHEMA = "upstate.multivariate-control-receiving/v1"
REOPEN = "upstate.multivariate-control-cold-reopen/v1"
HELPER = "source_tools/multivariate_control_receiving.py"


def _event(stage, **details):
    print(json.dumps({"stage": stage, **details}, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False), flush=True)


def _outside(path, root):
    if path == root or path.is_relative_to(root) or root.is_relative_to(path):
        raise ValueError("Keep matched-control receiving output outside the application and Workspace")


def _original_runs(workspace):
    """Snapshot completed original records without inventing or changing a run."""
    records = []
    for path in sorted((workspace.root / "runs").glob("*/run.json")):
        value = read_json(path)
        if value.get("state") == "complete":
            if value.get("id") != path.parent.name:
                raise ValueError("A completed original run changed its content identity")
            records.append({"id": value["id"], "selection": value["selection"],
                            "record": describe_file(workspace.root, path)})
    return records


def _preserve_original_runs(workspace, originals):
    for row in originals:
        path = verify_file(workspace.root, row["record"])
        value = read_json(path)
        if (value.get("id") != row["id"] or value.get("state") != "complete"
                or value.get("selection") != row["selection"]):
            raise ValueError("The matched-control continuation changed an original completed run")
    return {"completed_originals": len(originals), "identity": "MATCH"}


def _archive(workspace, output, selection):
    from model import study_transfer
    path = output / "matched-control-study.zip"
    receipt_path = output / "study-archive.json"
    if path.exists():
        inspected = study_transfer.inspect_transfer_archive(path, verify=True)
        if inspected["study"]["identity"]["selection"] != study_transfer.normalise(selection):
            raise ValueError("The retained archive belongs to another authored matched-control study")
        if inspected["manifest"]["project"] != workspace.project:
            raise ValueError("The retained archive belongs to another Workspace")
        if receipt_path.exists():
            receipt = read_json(receipt_path)
            if receipt["id"] != inspected["study"]["id"]:
                raise ValueError("The retained archive receipt changed its selected study")
            if receipt.get("sha256") != file_digest(path):
                raise ValueError("The retained selected Study ZIP differs from its original receipt")
            return receipt, inspected
        # An export can publish its complete archive before its caller saves the ACK.
        # Reconcile that exact original ZIP; never replace it with another selection.
        receipt = {"id": inspected["study"]["id"], "path": str(path),
                   "bytes": path.stat().st_size, "sha256": file_digest(path),
                   "recovered_complete_archive": True}
    else:
        receipt = study_transfer.export_study(
            workspace, path, selection,
            progress=lambda value: _event("matched-control-study-export", **value))
        inspected = study_transfer.inspect_transfer_archive(path, verify=True)
    atomic_json(receipt_path, receipt, immutable=True)
    return receipt, inspected


def _restore(output, archive, project):
    from model import portable
    destination = output / "received"
    receipt_path = output / "study-restore.json"
    if destination.exists():
        restored = portable.resume_restore(
            archive["path"], destination, expected_archive_sha256=archive["sha256"])
    else:
        restored = portable.restore(archive["path"], destination)
    if (restored["archive_sha256"] != archive["sha256"]
            or restored["project"] != project
            or Path(restored["application"]).resolve() != destination / "application"
            or Path(restored["workspace"]).resolve() != destination / "workspace"):
        raise ValueError("The received matched-control study changed its original archive or project")
    # Native resume may add its reconciliation status. Retain the first full receipt,
    # and keep the latest native reconciliation as a separate current result.
    if not receipt_path.exists():
        atomic_json(receipt_path, restored, immutable=True)
    atomic_json(output / "study-restore-current.json", restored)
    return restored


def _cold_reopen(restored, inspected, design, output, lock_fd):
    """Run the archive's own source in a clean Python process."""
    from source_tools.geographic_headwaters_reopen import _support
    support = _support()
    application = Path(restored["application"]).resolve(strict=True)
    workspace = Path(restored["workspace"]).resolve(strict=True)
    members = inspected["manifest"]["members"]
    if "application/" + HELPER not in members:
        raise ValueError("The selected Study must include its original matched-control receiving chapter")
    source_identity = support._application(application, members)
    attempt = uuid.uuid4().hex
    directory = output / "cold-reopen" / attempt
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    request = {"schema": REOPEN, "attempt_id": attempt,
               "application": str(application), "workspace": str(workspace),
               "project": restored["project"], "archive_sha256": restored["archive_sha256"],
               "study_id": inspected["study"]["id"], "design": design,
               "receiving_lock": _lock_identity(lock_fd, output / ".matched-control-receiving.lock")}
    request_path = directory / "request.json"
    result_path = directory / "result.json"
    atomic_json(request_path, request, immutable=True)
    request_sha = file_digest(request_path)
    command = [sys.executable, "-I", "-B", str(application / HELPER),
               "--reopen-request", str(request_path), "--request-sha256", request_sha,
               "--result", str(result_path), "--lock-fd", str(lock_fd)]
    atomic_json(directory / "launch.json",
                {"schema": REOPEN, "command": command, "started_at": now(),
                 "request_sha256": request_sha, "source_members": len(source_identity)},
                immutable=True)
    process = None
    try:
        with (directory / "stdout.log").open("xb", buffering=0) as stdout, \
                (directory / "stderr.log").open("xb", buffering=0) as stderr:
            process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=application, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr,
                                       pass_fds=(lock_fd,))
            _event("matched-control-cold-process", pid=process.pid, command=command)
            code = process.wait()
            os.fsync(stdout.fileno())
            os.fsync(stderr.fileno())
        if code:
            raise RuntimeError("The contained matched-control application exited "
                               + str(code) + "; inspect " + str(directory / "stderr.log"))
        result = read_json(result_path)
        if (result.get("schema") != REOPEN or result.get("attempt_id") != attempt
                or result.get("request_sha256") != request_sha or result.get("identity") != "MATCH"
                or result.get("project") != restored["project"]
                or result.get("study_id") != inspected["study"]["id"]
                or result.get("design_id") != design["id"]):
            raise ValueError("The contained application returned another saved design or Study")
        for name, identity in source_identity.items():
            if support._identity(support._member(application, name).lstat()) != identity:
                raise ValueError("The contained application source changed during cold reopening")
        return {**result, "attempt_directory": str(directory), "returncode": code,
                "stdout": str(directory / "stdout.log"), "stderr": str(directory / "stderr.log")}
    except BaseException:
        if process is not None and process.poll() is None:
            process.terminate()
            try:
                process.wait(timeout=5)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                process.kill()
                process.wait()
        raise


def reopen(request_path, request_sha256, result_path, lock_fd):
    request_path = Path(request_path).resolve(strict=True)
    if file_digest(request_path) != identifier(request_sha256):
        raise ValueError("The cold-reopen request changed")
    request = read_json(request_path)
    if request.get("schema") != REOPEN or Path(request["application"]).resolve() != APP:
        raise ValueError("Use the source contained in the selected original Study archive")
    lock = request["receiving_lock"]
    if _lock_identity(lock_fd, lock["path"]) != lock:
        raise ValueError("The contained application lost the original receiving lock")
    workspace = Workspace(Path(request["workspace"]).resolve(strict=True))
    if workspace.project != request["project"]:
        raise ValueError("The contained Workspace is not the selected original project")
    from model import multivariate_control, study_transfer
    verification = study_transfer.verify_received_studies(workspace)
    if request["study_id"] not in {row["id"] for row in verification}:
        raise ValueError("The native selected-study receiver lost the original design root")
    found = multivariate_control.inspect(workspace, request["design"]["id"])
    if found != request["design"]:
        raise ValueError("Cold reopening changed the retained design, adoption or native result")
    result = {"schema": REOPEN, "attempt_id": request["attempt_id"],
              "request_sha256": request_sha256, "project": workspace.project,
              "study_id": request["study_id"], "design_id": found["id"],
              "identity": "MATCH", "verified_studies": verification, "completed_at": now()}
    atomic_json(Path(result_path), result, immutable=True)
    return result


def receive(workspace, output, *, selection_path=None, design_id=None, execute=False,
            prepared_id=None):
    """Optional chapter of the maintained geographic receiving runner."""
    from model import multivariate_control, scenario_footprint, study_transfer
    if (selection_path is None) == (design_id is None):
        raise ValueError("Supply exactly one authored selection file or saved matched-control design ID")
    if type(execute) is not bool:
        raise ValueError("Choose explicitly whether to execute the new matched-control native case")
    output = Path(output).resolve()
    _outside(output, workspace.root)
    _outside(output, APP)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with receiving_lock(output / ".matched-control-receiving.lock") as lock_fd:
        if selection_path is not None:
            body = Path(selection_path).resolve(strict=True).read_bytes()
            selected = json.loads(body)
            atomic_bytes(output / "original-selection.json", body, immutable=True)
            proposed = multivariate_control.preview(workspace, selected)
            atomic_json(output / "preview.json", proposed)
            requested = {"selection_sha256": hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()}
        else:
            requested = {"design_id": identifier(design_id)}
            selected = multivariate_control.inspect(workspace, design_id)["selection"]
        baseline = workspace.inspect_run(identifier(selected["baseline_run_id"]))
        footprint = scenario_footprint.get_footprint(
            workspace, identifier(selected["restoration_footprint_id"]))
        if baseline["state"] != "complete":
            raise ValueError("Receive a completed original baseline before a new control study")
        restoration = workspace.inspect_run(footprint["run_id"])
        if restoration["state"] != "complete":
            raise ValueError("Receive the completed original restoration used by this design")
        if prepared_id is not None:
            prepared_id = identifier(prepared_id)
            prepared = read_json(workspace.root / "geographic-headwaters" / prepared_id / "prepared.json")
            if (prepared["project_id"] != workspace.project["id"]
                    or prepared["id"] != prepared_id or prepared["baseline_run_id"] != baseline["id"]
                    or restoration["id"] not in prepared["alternative_run_ids"]):
                raise ValueError("The design does not use the selected original Geographic baseline and restoration")
        identity = {"schema": SCHEMA, "project_id": workspace.project["id"], **requested,
                    "prepared_id": prepared_id, "execute": execute,
                    "baseline_run_id": baseline["id"], "restoration_run_id": restoration["id"]}
        operation_id = digest(identity)
        state_path = output / "receiving.json"
        if state_path.exists():
            state = read_json(state_path)
            if state.get("identity") != identity or state.get("id") != operation_id:
                raise ValueError("Resume the same authored matched-control chapter in this output directory")
        else:
            state = {"schema": SCHEMA, "id": operation_id, "identity": identity,
                     "original_completed_runs": _original_runs(workspace),
                     "created_at": now(), "stages": {}}
            atomic_json(state_path, state)

        def save(**value):
            state.update(value, updated_at=now())
            atomic_json(state_path, state)

        def phase(name, action):
            _preserve_original_runs(workspace, state["original_completed_runs"])
            started = time.perf_counter()
            save(state="running", active_stage=name)
            _event(name, operation_id=operation_id, state="running")
            try:
                result = action()
                _preserve_original_runs(workspace, state["original_completed_runs"])
            except BaseException as error:
                save(state="failed" if isinstance(error, Exception) else "interrupted",
                     error={"stage": name, "type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)})
                raise
            previous = state["stages"].get(name, {})
            state["stages"][name] = {"state": "complete",
                "first_completed_at": previous.get("first_completed_at", now()),
                "first_elapsed_seconds": previous.get("first_elapsed_seconds", time.perf_counter()-started),
                "latest_elapsed_seconds": time.perf_counter()-started}
            state.pop("error", None)
            save(active_stage=None)
            return result

        if design_id is None:
            design = phase("matched-control-prepare",
                           lambda: multivariate_control.prepare(workspace, selected,
                               progress=lambda value: _event("matched-control-design-progress", progress=value)))
            design_id = design["id"]
        else:
            design = multivariate_control.inspect(workspace, design_id)
        save(design_id=design_id, design_state=design["state"])
        atomic_json(output / "design.json", design)
        if design["state"] == "prepared":
            adopted = phase("matched-control-adopt", lambda: multivariate_control.adopt(workspace, design_id))
            save(adoption=adopted["adoption"])
            if execute:
                def execute_control():
                    from model import experiments
                    result = multivariate_control.execute(workspace, design_id)
                    atomic_json(output / "native-experiment.json", result)
                    summary = experiments.read_summary(workspace, adopted["adoption"]["experiment_id"])
                    if summary is not None:
                        atomic_json(output / "native-summary.json", summary)
                    if result.get("state") != "complete":
                        raise ValueError("The original matched-control experiment is not complete; inspect its retained progress and resume this same chapter")
                    return result
                execution = phase("matched-control-native", execute_control)
                save(execution=execution)
        else:
            # Infeasible and threshold-rejected assessments are complete scientific
            # records. Export their full treatment/support evidence without adoption.
            save(interpretation="No accepted control design; the full original treatment remains retained.",
                 native_execution="not_adopted")
        design = multivariate_control.inspect(workspace, design_id)
        atomic_json(output / "design.json", design)
        transfer_selection = {
            "schema": study_transfer.SELECTION_SCHEMA,
            "title": selected["title"] + " — editable matched-control study",
            "roots": [{"kind": "multivariate-controls", "id": design_id}],
            "include_related_results": True,
        }
        preview = phase("matched-control-study-preview",
                        lambda: study_transfer.preview(workspace, transfer_selection))
        atomic_json(output / "study-preview.json", preview)
        archive, inspected = phase("matched-control-study-export",
                                  lambda: _archive(workspace, output, transfer_selection))
        save(archive=archive, study_id=inspected["study"]["id"])
        restored = phase("matched-control-study-restore",
                         lambda: _restore(output, archive, workspace.project))
        save(restored=restored)
        cold = phase("matched-control-contained-reopen",
                     lambda: _cold_reopen(restored, inspected, design, output, lock_fd))
        save(state="complete", active_stage=None, design=design, independent_reopen=cold,
             preserved_originals=_preserve_original_runs(workspace, state["original_completed_runs"]),
             outcome=design["state"],
             producer_view="Pending actual desktop/narrow operation and viewing of every outgoing attachment.")
        return state


def main(argv=None):
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Read-only contained matched-control Study reopening")
    parser.add_argument("--reopen-request", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--request-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--result", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--lock-fd", type=int, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    result = reopen(args.reopen_request, args.request_sha256, args.result, args.lock_fd)
    print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
